ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: ProTop uses your photos when you update your profile picture or attach an image.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: ProTop uses the camera when you take a photo for your profile, a note or an attachment.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: ProTop uses your location for the weather on Home when you ask for it.
ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: ProTop uses Face ID to lock the app and protect your account.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: ProTop uses the microphone for voice notes.
